description: One data row of central/person_month.csv, read as an object of column name to cell text; an empty cell is null. The header row must be exactly the columns of x-columns, in that order. Generated from meterline_gold/write.py and meterline_gold/dataset_docs.py by meterline_gold.contract; do not edit by hand. Meaning of each column: docs/reference/gold-datasets.md and the gold spec, sections 6 to 8.

active_days.description: Days of the month with any usage or activity row.

active_days_by_tool.description: JSON object of tool (provider or provider/product) to the person's active days with it.

attribution_day.description: Last employed day of the month: the day whose organisation row attributes the person.

cache_rate.description: Cache-read tokens divided by all input tokens, where both are known.

cost_center.description: Cost centre of the person or unit, from the organisation files.

cost_ref.description: Sum of the person's cost_ref over the month and all providers; 0.00 when nothing is priced.

cost_ref_by_provider.description: JSON object of provider to the person's cost_ref at that provider.

credits.description: AI credits consumed, for providers that meter in credits.

employed_days.description: Days of the month on which the person is employed.

function.description: Function of the person or unit, from the organisation files.

intensity_band.description: Band of the person's month cost from the policy's bands.

is_final.description: True when the provider will no longer revise the figure.

level.description: Level of the person, from the organisation files.

manager_key.description: person_key of the person's manager on the attribution day.

month_status.description: complete for a finished month, running for the month in progress.

person_key.description: Pseudonymous person key: a keyed hash of the person id, stable for one hashing key.

population.description: Population label of the person, from the organisation files.

premium_share.description: Share of the person's cost_ref that went to premium-tier models.

projected_cost_ref.description: Month-end projection of cost_ref for a running month; empty when complete.

requests.description: Sum of the person's requests in the month.

rows_unknown_model.description: Number of the person's person_day rows whose model is not in the price list.

rows_unpriced.description: Number of the person's person_day rows that could not be priced (cost_ref_status unpriced).

schema_version.description: GOLD_SCHEMA_VERSION of the build that wrote the file; the same on every row.

tokens_cache_read.description: Input tokens read from a cache.

tokens_input_total.description: All input tokens: uncached, cache read and cache write.

unit_id.description: Organisation unit id from the organisation files.

title: gold-dataset-person_month
x-cost-column-rule: `cost_ref` is the person's month total across providers; `cost_ref_by_provider` splits it. Seat fees are in no person's cost. `projected_cost_ref` projects a running month: do not add it to `cost_ref`.
x-grain: One row per person with an employed day in the month.
